lines: Takes half body he thus said indeed by Śambhu; whatever of his in mind blossoming grants.
l4.sanskrit_cite: haratyardhaśarīraṃ sa ityuktaṃ kila śambhunā yadyadevāsya manasi vikāsitvaṃ prayacchati
